thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT — SEV2: DB_THREAD_POOL_EXHAUST (critical)
incident-bot: Rules matched: postgres_connection_exhaustion, redis_maxclients_hit; region: us-east-1; symptom summary: many pgbouncer_waiters, redis maxclients reached, elevated 5xx on ingestion endpoints

Maria Chen: Acked PD and taking lead. I'm online and triaging now. anyone else seeing traffic spike?

Amir SRE: Yeah, Grafana shows a sharp inbound spike from internal-batch at ~13:02 UTC. Also notice a canary deploy for api-service at 13:01 per deploy-bot.

Maria Chen: Initial quick triage: pgbouncer queueing (waiting_clients ~400), redis primary at maxclients (~9.6k), write-heavy endpoints returning 503/504. Customer impact appears focused on ingestion/telemetry writes.

Maria Chen: Running emergency mitigations now:
1) pause batch-producer cronjob
2) increase pgbouncer pool size and reload
3) spin new redis replicas and temporarily raise redis maxclients
4) add gateway rule to early-429 noisy API keys

Amir SRE: I'll handle the redis ops. prepping commands and checking kernel fd limits before bumping maxclients.

Maria Chen: commands I'm running:
```
# redis connected clients
redis-cli -h redis-primary-us-east info clients | grep connected_clients
redis-cli -h redis-primary-us-east CLIENT LIST | wc -l

# pgbouncer queue
psql -h pgbouncer-host -U pgbouncer -c "select database, total_wait_time, waiting_clients from pgbouncer_stats order by waiting_clients desc limit 5;"
```

deploy-bot: api-service@prod: canary rollout at 13:01:12 UTC — 68/100 pods updated

Dave Patel: I'm being escalated, will be on in ~4m.

PagerDuty: Escalation -> Dave Patel (no ack from backup) at 13:07 UTC

Maria Chen: applied k8s patch to suspend batch-producer: `kubectl patch cronjob batch-producer -n jobs -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`

Amir SRE: spun up two redis t3-small replicas and started replica sync. Before bump: connected_clients=9800, after replica join: ~6.2k across nodes. I bumped maxclients 10000->15000 temporarily; verified ulimit and kernel settings OK.

Maria Chen: increased pgbouncer pool size 120->240 and reloaded. waiting_clients dropped from ~420 -> ~30 and queue latency improved.

deploy-bot: Rollout watcher: api-service canary showing increased latency on the new version — rollback suggestion prompted.

Maria Chen: hold rollback for now — prefer to stabilize with throttles and scaling. rollback would lose extra capacity from new pods.

Amir SRE: Observed that partner-service X emitted a storm of parallel writes; opened internal ticket to throttle their producer.

Maria Chen: partial traffic shaping: added gateway rule to send top noisy API keys to degraded-mode (read-only or early-429). Applied change.

Maria Chen: timeline so far:
- 13:01 canary deploy started
- 13:02 batch-job fleet restart -> traffic spike
- 13:06 PagerDuty triggered
- 13:08 throttles + pgbouncer scaling applied
- 13:12 redis replicas joined + maxclients bump
- 13:18 visible error rate down from ~6% -> ~2%

PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by Maria Chen at 13:07 UTC

Dave Patel: I'm in; taking over from Maria. I'll monitor for 30m and own RCA doc. Maria, any outstanding ops I should keep an eye on?

Maria Chen: handing off now. outstanding actions:
- set permanent concurrency limits for batch-job producers (infra ticket)
- right-size pgbouncer pools for api-service (DB team)
- add circuit-breaker for partner-service writes to prevent future floods
- schedule follow-up to review deploy canary gating (deploy team)
owners: Maria (RCA lead), Amir (DB tuning), Dave (ops follow-up)

Dave Patel: ack. Creating SEV2 incident doc and follow-ups. Notifying support for customer comms and finance for potential credits. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: thanks — I'm stepping out for a short break. ping if anything regresses. :coffee:

Dave Patel: handover accepted. current metrics: error-rate ~1.7%, pgbouncer waiting_clients < 10, redis clients ~5.9k across primary+replicas.

PagerDuty: Incident set to monitor-only for 2h; no further pages.

Maria Chen: I'll draft the postmortem; SEV2 doc target within 48h. logging follow-up tickets now.

Amir SRE: adding note in infra-runbook about `maxclients` bump risks and kernel/ulimit checks. Will include playbook steps for safe bump and replica-join checklist.

Dave Patel: closing the thread here. solid teamwork — nice job triaging and stabilizing. :tada:
